subject: general
question:
Find the correct alternative that when filled in the blanks in the same sequence will make the series logically complete.

_ _ Z V _ Z _ A _ V A _ _ A _
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• ZAVAAZZV → **Z A** Z / V **V** Z / **A** A **A** / V A **Z / Z** A **V** 
 
• VAAVZZVZ → **V A** Z / V **A** Z / **V** A **Z** / V A Z / V</s
